question: Will English Wikipedia siteinfo API show ≥7,275,500 articles at 12:00 UTC on Dec 10, 2026?
resolutionCriteria:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes, ≥7,275,500 articles": Wins if the `articles` field returned by the English Wikipedia siteinfo API (`https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&meta=siteinfo&siprop=statistics&format=json`) is greater than or equal to 7,275,500 when queried at 2026-12-10T12:00:00Z, provided that query time falls strictly after 2026-11-24T09:56:34Z and at or before 2026-12-10T19:00:00Z.
- "No, fewer than 7,275,500": Wins if the `articles` field returned by the same API is less than 7,275,500 when queried at 2026-12-10T12:00:00Z, provided that query time falls strictly after 2026-11-24T09:56:34Z and at or before 2026-12-10T19:00:00Z.

Clarifications:
- The article count is the value of `query.statistics.articles` in the JSON response from `https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&meta=siteinfo&siprop=statistics&format=json`; this counts only content pages in the main namespace that contain at least one internal wikilink and are not redirects, as defined by MediaWiki's article-count methodology.
fact: English Wikipedia's siteinfo API reports 7,269,550 articles at 2026-11-26T15:20:04.673Z; the market threshold is 7,275,500, so the count is below the threshold (gap 5,950).
relevance: The market resolves on the articles field of this exact API when queried at 2026-12-10T12:00:00Z. This is the primary record itself, not a secondary report.
working: threshold - current = 7275500 - 7269550 = 5950. Days to the 10 Dec 12:00 UTC check = 13.86. Net additions required to cross = 5,950 / 13.86 = 429 articles per day.
